name: Malachite
desc: A slab of botryoidal malachite — grape-like domes of silky green banding, light and dark rings wrapping each bubble, fibrous luster catching a slow raking light as the lapidary's polish plane advances and the concentric bands migrate inward.

blobs.doc: number of botryoidal domes packed across the slab

energy.doc: strength of the silky sheen and specular highlight

density.doc: fineness of the radial fibrous silk striations

scale.doc: dome scale — zoom into the botryoids

hue.doc: base mineral hue (140 = true malachite green)

speed.doc: how fast the polish plane advances and the light rakes

x.doc: raking light azimuth across the polished face

y.doc: light elevation — where the silky sheen lands

style.doc: malachite: silky light-and-dark green rings · azurite: deep azure banding with green malachite streaks · chrysocolla: soft teal-cyan bands · tonal: non-representational greyscale silky banding, form from light alone

seed.doc: a new specimen — fresh dome layout, radii and band sequence
